This is a '''list of staff members''' who worked on the [[Generation I|first generation]] games [[Pokémon Red and Green Versions]] for the [[Game Boy]], per the games' [[credits]]. The games were published by [[Nintendo]] and developed by [[Game Freak]] and [[Creatures, Inc.]] All names are given in Western order.
